calls.summary:
We need to summarize the sales call transcript in 2-3 sentences, focusing on discussed topics (product, features, pain points), key participants and roles, and next steps/action items.

Key participants: Fredrik Jørgensen (customer, Oda), Christian Liebenow (GrowthBook sales rep). Product: GrowthBook (experimentation platform, self-hosted enterprise version). Discussed features: self-hosting, sticky bucketing, pre-exposure analysis, AI capabilities, product analytics. Pain points: Oda is small (25 people, 60 experiments) and cost-sensitive; they want enterprise features but without high platform fee, support, SLAs; they are on tight budget and can't afford $50k/year platform fee (discounted from $100k). Christian proposes $50k/year platform fee + user fees, with 10% discount for case study/press release. Fredrik says CTO will reject, hoping for no platform fee (essentially pro version). Next steps: Christian will share deck via email; Fredrik will discuss with CTO; Christian may check if further discount possible but says $50k is minimum. Action items: Fredrik to talk to CTO, Christian to send deck and follow up via email.

calls.title: Oda + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The meeting detailed a tailored enterprise proposal from GrowthBook to ODA, proposing an annual platform fee starting at $100,000, with a discount of $50,000 due to budget limitations. User fees were established at $1,250 for authorized users and $500 for read-only users. A commitment to a case study could yield an additional discount, pending satisfactory outcomes. ODA's CTO’s budget constraints were a significant hurdle for acceptance. Additionally, GrowthBook highlighted key product features, including self-hosting capabilities and robust support models, while confirming ODA's preference for experimentation features, leading to a proposed partnership aimed for conclusion by April 30.
